en.headline: Three Tuen Mun Road crashes injure at least eight
en.dek: Police logged three collisions in about 20 minutes on Friday evening near Siu Hong, and queues toward Yuen Long stretched past 10 kilometres.
body: At least three collisions on Tuen Mun Road toward Yuen Long injured at least eight people on Friday evening, Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao reported.

Police received the first report at 5:53pm. Four private cars collided in the fast lane near Siu Hong MTR station. At least five people, three men and two women, were hurt. Reports said all were minor injuries, including one neck sprain, and ambulances took four of them to Tuen Mun Hospital.

A second call at 6:05pm reported a light goods vehicle and a private car colliding near Yan Oi Tong. At 6:11pm police were told two private cars had collided near Siu Hong, with three people injured. Those three declined to go to hospital, the reports said.

The Transport Department said some lanes near Siu Hong station were closed because of the collisions and reopened around 7pm, with the queue still clearing. Hong Kong 01 reported that by 7:40pm the tail of the Yuen Long-bound queue had reached near Sham Tseng Tsuen, a line of more than 10 kilometres.

zh.headline: 屯門公路傍晚三宗車禍 最少八人受傷
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島報道，周五傍晚約20分鐘內兆康一帶接連三宗交通意外，往元朗車龍一度逾10公里。
body: 屯門公路往元朗方向周五傍晚接連發生最少三宗交通意外，最少八人受傷，《香港01》及星島均有報道。
警方下午5時53分接報，四輛私家車在港鐵兆康站對開快線首尾相撞。最少五人受傷，包括三男兩女，報道指全部屬輕傷，其中一人頸部扭傷，救護車將其中四人送往屯門醫院。
下午6時05分，屯門公路近仁愛堂對開再有輕型貨車與私家車相撞。6時11分，警方接報兆康站對開兩輛私家車相撞，三人受傷，但全部拒絕送院。
運輸署表示，意外令兆康站對開部分行車線一度封閉，晚上7時許解封後車龍仍有待消散。《香港01》報道，截至晚上7時40分，往元朗車龍龍尾曾排至深井村對開，長逾10公里。
